identity.name: AGV control HMI
identity.vibe: Industrial control panel written like an engineering document. Quiet, precise, utilitarian, like a technical datasheet or instrument panel. Calm light 'paper' surface where colour only appears when a state needs attention. Nothing decorative; every visual choice has a safety or legibility reason.
anti_patterns: colour-only status (always pair with a text label or left bar)
external font CDNs (fonts are self-hosted, runs offline)

color.theme: Light only, on purpose. The colour meanings must stay the same whatever the OS theme is.

neutrals.surface-2: #E4E8EF (chips, pills, log well, key caps, inactive fills)
neutrals.ink-3: #666E7F (tertiary: small mono labels, units, eyebrows; tuned for AA at 10-11px)

accent.accent-2: #2F5F94 (steel blue, active nav, 'running' buttons, pressed jog buttons, focus outlines, live input lamps, key tiles)

hazard.use: warnings, advisories, 'unknown', energised outputs. Text on hazard always uses the dark hazard-ink, never the yellow

stop.use: faults, errors, stop/disarm, stale data, occupied zones

rules: Colour appears only when it carries meaning; the resting UI is greyscale plus navy.
A status is shown as a pale wash background + a 3-4px left bar in the solid colour + a text label. Never a fill alone.
Filled solid buttons (ok/accent-2/stop) always use white text; hover is brightness(1.12).
Disabled = opacity .3-.32. Stale data = dimmed + grayscale, or a hatched red pattern / a red banner when 'stale' could be mistaken for 'clear'.

families.display: Archivo 600/700 (headings, page title). Tight negative tracking
families.sans: IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600 (body copy, hints, notes)
families.mono: IBM Plex Mono 400/500/600 (all labels, nav, buttons, values, units, logs, codes). Mono is the dominant voice of the UI

scale.h3: 600 15px Archivo; on the monitor page, sub-headings are 10.5px mono uppercase instead
scale.eyebrow_small: 500 11px mono, UPPERCASE, letter-spacing .11em, ink-3. Sits inline after an h2 and carries technical IDs (e.g. 'NODE 10 · TPDO1 0x18A')
scale.tile_value_hero: 44px mono (the single most-copied value on screen)
scale.hero_summary: clamp(30px,4vw,58px) Archivo for the main status headline

habits: UPPERCASE + wide letter-spacing for all small labels
middle-dot ' · ' as a separator in metadata strings
en-dash '–' or em-dash '—' as the placeholder for an empty value
honest lowercase states like 'connecting…', 'no track', 'no link'

shape_and_surface.corners: Square everywhere (border-radius 0). The only exceptions: round status lamps (a lamp is conventionally round, and a square one would read as a button) and 2px on inline <code>.
shape_and_surface.borders: 1px solid rule on almost everything. Header has a 2px solid ink bottom border as the single heavy line. Keyboard key caps get a 2px bottom border.
shape_and_surface.emphasis_device: Left bar: border-left 3-4px in a semantic colour, used for callouts, alarm rows, fault chips, warning tiles and the panel strip.
shape_and_surface.elevation: Flat. Layers are shown by paper vs white surface vs surface-2 ground, never by shadow.

layout.structure: App shell with a fixed viewport height; the document itself never scrolls. Top header bar, then a 2-column grid: 300px left telemetry rail + a fluid main column.
layout.header: White bar, padding 10px 18px, 2px ink bottom border. Left to right: bold 'AGV control' title, then uppercase mono tab nav (active tab = accent-wash ground + 1px rule border + accent-2 text), then status pill and Wi-Fi bars+dBm pushed right with margin-left:auto.
layout.left_rail: White, 1px right border, padding 14px. 2x2 grid of telemetry tiles, a compact lidar zone row (three small lamps), node state chips, then a monospace log well that fills the remaining height and is the only thing that scrolls.
layout.main: Padding 18px. Content centred with max-width 900px and stacked sections. Control areas like the jog pad are narrower (520px) and centred.
layout.section_pattern: h2 (Archivo) + inline mono eyebrow, then an auto-fit grid of tiles (minmax 110px, gap 8px), then optional short sans notes.
layout.spacing: Tight and regular: 4/6/8/10/12/14/16/18/24px. Tile gap 8px, section/bar spacing 16px.
layout.responsive: Below 820px the rail stacks above main and the page may scroll ('unreachable controls are worse than a scrollbar'). Jog pad buttons become square. Two-column lists collapse to one.

components.telemetry_tile: White box, 1px rule, padding 8px 12px, stacked vertically: UPPERCASE 10px mono label / big mono value / small mono unit. Variants: .key (accent-wash ground, accent-2 border, 34px value), .tag (44px value), .warn / .bad (wash ground + 3px coloured left bar + coloured value).
components.status_pill: Mono 11.5px uppercase chip on surface-2 with 1px rule; ok/bad variants use the wash ground, solid-colour border and solid-colour text.
components.big_button: Mono 12px uppercase tracked, padding 13px 24px, square, 1px rule on white. Hover changes border and text to accent-2. Semantic filled variants: go=green, run=steel blue, off=red, all with white text. Focus = 2px accent-2 outline, 2px offset.
components.danger_button: Quiet outlined by default; red outline on hover; fully red fill once armed (two-step confirm look).
components.jog_pad: 3x3 grid of square white cells, gap 8px. Each cell has a large glyph, an uppercase mono name and a small key hint. Pressed = accent-2 fill, white text, scale(.97). The centre stop cell uses surface-2 and turns red when active.
components.callout_warn: Hazard-wash ground, 1px rule, 4px hazard left bar, hazard-ink text, padding 12px 16px, max 74ch. A second variant uses a stop-red left bar.
components.lists_tables: White bordered container; rows split by rule-soft hairlines; compact 4-6px vertical padding; CSS grid columns; mono channel/key column, sans name column, right-aligned mono value with a muted unit.
components.alarm_row: Grid row with a 4px left bar coloured by level (info=rule, warn=hazard, error=stop) plus a wash ground and an uppercase level text label.
components.lamp: 14px circle, 1px rule, surface-2 fill when off. Input on = accent-2 fill. Output on = hazard yellow (inputs and outputs deliberately differ). Zone occupied = stop red. Unknown = hazard. Stale = 45° red/white hatched stripes.
components.chip: 600 10px mono uppercase, padding 3px 7px, surface-2 ground; warn/error use the matching wash.
components.kbd: surface-2 ground, 1px rule with a 2px bottom border, 11px mono.
components.linear_track: White 74px strip with a hairline centre line, a thin ink-3 zero marker, small solid blue/green rectangular position markers labelled in 10px mono, and faint full-scale numbers at the corners.
components.wifi_indicator: Four rising 3px bars; unfilled bars stay visible as outlines. Paired with the dBm number in mono. Amber when weak, red when down, never a filled block.
components.hero_summary_panel: 2px rule border, generous clamp padding, bold tracked status line, 3-column overview with huge Archivo/mono values, and a sequence of bordered step pills (current = 2px ink border + bold, next = underlined).
components.canvas_graphics: Drawn using the same CSS variables (white surface, rule-soft grid, ink-3 labels, accent-2 points), so charts match the UI.

interaction_and_motion.motion: Minimal and functional: 60-80ms transitions on background, border and position only. No easing flourishes, no entrance animations.
interaction_and_motion.touch: touch-action: manipulation; user-select disabled on controls only. Text stays selectable elsewhere so fault codes and IPs can be copied.
interaction_and_motion.hover: Text/border shift to accent-2. Filled buttons brighten.
interaction_and_motion.focus: Visible 2px solid outline (accent-2, or stop for destructive controls).
interaction_and_motion.states_philosophy: When data is unknown or stale, say so loudly. Never let missing data look like a calm or clear state.

voice.tone: Terse, technical, precise. Engineer to operator.
voice.copy_style: Short uppercase mono labels (BATTERY, STATE, LEFT, SETPOINT); units spelled the technical way (r/min, mm, rad/s, V); hex/object IDs shown openly (0x18A, 407Ch); plain-sentence hints in sans that explain why, with key words bolded.
